# Don't make style-only or formatting-only changes

Express doesn't accept code-style, formatting or aesthetic changes without a concrete reason. Keep the diff to the functional change.

**Why:** Stated on 5 PRs by 2 reviewers.

## Examples from PR review history

- > Thanks for your contribution, but we don’t accept changes to the code style unless there’s a good reason.
  — @bjohansebas on PR #6844: https://github.com/expressjs/express/pull/6844#pullrequestreview-3353786940
- > We generally don't accept formatting-only PRs.
  — @krzysdz on PR #7155: https://github.com/expressjs/express/pull/7155#issuecomment-4177750742
- > Also, please don’t make style changes
  — @bjohansebas on PR #6947: https://github.com/expressjs/express/pull/6947#pullrequestreview-3568034772
